name: rp12-budget-tool
description: Static RP12 budget configurator and client release package builder.

scripts.build: npm run build:selector && npm run build:ldm
scripts.release:prepare: npm run generate:combinations && npm run build:client && node scripts/prepare-client-release.mjs
scripts.release:client: npm run generate:combinations && npm run build:client && node scripts/prepare-client-release.mjs --zip
